Intuitive Healing • Reiki • Shamanic Healing • Conscious Breathwork • Spiritual Guidance • Meditation • Workshops • Sacred Tours & Retreats

Jayanti Woods is an internationally known Intuitive Healer and Inspirational Teacher, Reiki Master & Teacher, contemporary shaman and facilitator.

With a background spanning Natural Therapies, Conscious Breathwork/Rebirthing, Shamanism, Quantum Dynamics, Reiki, Theta Healing, Yoga and Meditation, Jayanti has been walking the path of healing and teaching for more than 25 years.

The name “Jayanti” was gifted to her by her Indian spiritual master, Shri Munraj, in the early 1990s. He told her that Jayanti translates as “The Goddess of Flame”.

It is Jayanti’s passion to inspire and guide others to ignite their own Soul Flame and create a life that feels more aligned, conscious and connected.

For more than 25 years, Jayanti has led meditation and chant groups on the Gold Coast. Her work has expanded to include individual healing sessions, spiritual counselling, shamanic gatherings, workshops, retreats and sacred spiritual tours.

🌹 ~ EXPLORE JAYANTI’S HEALING & WORKSHOPS ~

Jayanti offers a diverse range of experiences. If you are unsure which session or workshop is right for you, contact Jayanti directly to discuss your needs.

🌿 INTUITIVE HEALING SESSIONS

Jayanti works intuitively, drawing from a range of modalities to facilitate the healing or energetic shift she feels is appropriate for each individual.

Sessions can be tailored to your personal intentions and may incorporate:

• Chakra Balancing
• Spiritual Healing
• Shamanic Healing
• Soul Retrieval
• Spiritual Development & Counselling
• Conscious Breathwork / Rebirthing
• Reiki
• Energy Clearing
• Quantum Dynamics
• Channeled Guidance
• Meditation

Sessions are available face-to-face as well as remotely via Zoom, Skype and other online platforms.

✨ INDIVIDUAL HEALING SESSION PRICING

1–1.5 hours — $175
Suitable for:

• Reiki
• Private Meditation Lessons
• Energy Clearing
• Chakra Balancing

2.5–3 hours — $225
Longer sessions may combine:

• Spiritual, emotional & energy healing
• Channeled guidance
• Spiritual development & counselling
• Shamanic healing / Soul Retrieval
• Chakra balancing & energy clearing
• Rebirthing / Conscious Breathwork
• Energy clearing, chakra balancing & Reiki

Individual sessions are available in person and online.


🌸 REIKI
Jayanti is a Reiki Master & Teacher and offers both Reiki healing sessions and Reiki training.

Her Reiki work is centred around relaxation, spiritual practice and energetic wellbeing.

🌿 REIKI LEVEL I TRAINING

A one-day introductory Reiki workshop for those wanting to learn Reiki for themselves and others.

The training includes:

• History of Reiki
• Two Reiki attunements
• Learning how to give a Reiki treatment
• Receiving a Reiki healing
• Dr Usui’s Reiki meditation practice
• Self-healing practices
• Comprehensive manual
• Reiki Level I certificate upon completion

Jayanti’s Healing Sanctuary
38 Murev Way, Carrara

Investment — $350

$100 deposit required to reserve your place.

Fee includes full tuition, comprehensive manual, teas, refreshments and certificate.

🌹 REIKI LEVEL II TRAINING

Reiki Level II deepens the practice introduced at Reiki I and introduces three sacred Reiki symbols.

Training includes:

• Reiki II attunement
• Three sacred Reiki symbols
• Distant / absent healing
• Chakra balancing with crystals & Reiki
• Crystal Reiki grids
• Reiki healing with crystals
• Pendulum work
• Crystal healing
• Reiki II certification

Prerequisite: Reiki Level I. If Level I was completed with another Reiki Master, a copy of your Reiki Level I certificate is required.

Jayanti’s Healing Sanctuary, Carrara

Investment — $710

$150 deposit required to reserve your place.

Fee includes full tuition, comprehensive manual, morning & afternoon refreshments and certificate.


🌿 MUNAY KI RITES TRAINING
A three-day Munay Ki workshop with Teacher Level Certification.

The workshop includes:

• The nine Munay Ki Rites of initiation
• Comprehensive manual
• Pi Stone of Serpentine
• Tuition on how to perform the Rites

Following completion of the required assignments, participants can learn to share the Rites with others and conduct their own workshops.

Contact Jayanti for current dates.

Friday — 6pm–10pm
Saturday & Sunday — 10am–5pm

Jayanti’s Healing Sanctuary
Carrara QLD 4211

Investment — $750

$150 deposit required to confirm your place.


🌙 SHAMANIC JOURNEY WORKSHOP
Explore the traditional shamanic practice of journeying through drumming, movement and guided practice.

The workshop explores:

• Shamanic journeying
• Accessing lower and upper worlds
• Discovering your power animal
• Connecting with spirit guides
• Gathering information, wisdom and insight
• Connecting with Grandmothers, Angels, Masters, shamans and ancestors
• Drumming and movement
• Connecting with the shaman within

Investment — $620

$150 deposit required to reserve your place.

Contact Jayanti to register your interest.


🌺 EMBRACING THE CALL OF THE ANCIENT
A sacred day exploring ancient Peruvian shamanic teachings, ancestral healing and balancing the inner feminine and masculine.

The experience includes sacred rites, shamanic journeying, drumming and circle work, with a focus on connection, reflection and spiritual exploration.

10am–4pm

Investment — $155
﻿

🌹 WOMEN’S & DIVINE FEMININE WORKSHOPS
Jayanti facilitates experiences centred around the Divine Feminine, sacred ceremony, movement, meditation, energy work and spiritual connection.

Her workshops may explore:

• Divine Feminine energy
• Inner feminine and masculine balance
• Sacred ritual
• Ancestral healing
• Shamanic teachings
• Meditation
• Movement
• Ceremony
• Heart connection

These experiences are offered as spiritual and personal-development practices.


🌏 SACRED TOURS & RETREATS
For more than 30 years, Jayanti has led spiritual journeys to India and other sacred destinations.

Through Jayanti’s Sacred Tours, participants are invited to immerse themselves in spiritually significant locations through meditation, yoga, ceremony, cultural experiences and personal reflection.

Destinations have included:

• India
• Bali
• Other sacred and spiritually significant locations

Retreats may incorporate:

• Daily yoga
• Guided meditation
• Transformational workshops
• Conscious Breathwork / Rebirthing
• Massage
• Purification ceremonies
• Sacred temple visits
• Cultural experiences
• Group connection
• Accommodation and meals, depending on the retreat

Upcoming tour and retreat dates and pricing vary. Contact Jayanti directly for current information.

Jayanti offers individual meditation sessions as well as guided meditation circles, and has 2 guided meditations for purchase and download by simply emailing her. These are part of the Sacred Shakti Meditations Series, by Jayanti Woods. 

{Shakti is the primordial cosmic energy and is referred to as the Divine Mother or Mother Goddess, the source of all. Shakti is the universal principle of divine feminine creative power or energy. Shakti is the divine force, manifesting in all of creation. She has many names, and is the ecstatic play of Consciousness.}

Jayanti's meditation work focuses on stillness, Soul connection, chakra alignment and developing greater conscious awareness.

RECORDED MEDITATIONS
Explore the descriptions below to find the meditation that resonates with you.

To purchase a recording, simply email Jayanti at ✉️ jayanti@jayantijay.com with the name of your chosen meditation. Jayanti will provide payment details, and once payment has been received, you’ll be emailed a link to download your recording.

Read about each of her meditations HERE:

Chakra Colour Meditation
The Chakra Colour meditation systematically cleans, purifies and charges your chakra system. You will feel complete and energized.
Duration: 21 minutes

Higher Self Alignment
The Higher Self Alignment is all about taking control of your great power. You connect with the cosmic force of pure energy that is your higher self, and the grounding energies of Mother Earth. Drawing them to your heart centre, you find peace within that power.
Duration: 33 minutes


🌕 FULL MOON MEDITATION
Jayanti also facilitates in person Full Moon meditation evenings where participants gather in sacred circle for meditation, reflection and spiritual connection.

Investment — $25

Venue:
Jayanti’s Sacred Sanctuary, Carrara QLD
Contact Jayanti for current dates and booking details.

Jayanti’s work brings together body, mind, emotions, energy and spiritual connection.

She works intuitively, recognising that every person’s journey is different and tailoring sessions and experiences according to the individual.

Whether you come for Reiki, intuitive healing, meditation, breathwork, shamanic work, spiritual guidance or a longer retreat experience, Jayanti creates a space for reflection, exploration and personal transformation.

🌿 EXPERIENCE & TRAINING

Jayanti’s background includes:

• Reiki Master & Teacher
• Natural Therapies
• Conscious Breathwork / Rebirthing
• Shamanism
• Quantum Dynamics
• Theta Healing
• Yoga & Meditation Teaching
• Neuro-Linguistic Programming & Neurological Repatterning
• Certificate IV in Assessment & Workplace Training
• Christopher Howard’s Platform & Presentation Skills Training
• 2005 Yoga Teacher Training

Professional affiliations include:

• Member — National Federation of Healers Inc
• Associate Member — Australasian Board of Psychosomatic Therapy Inc
• Past President & Life Member — Shri Haidakhan Babaji Foundation

📞 BOOK WITH JAYANTI

📱 0415 382 272

✉️ jayanti@jayantijay.com

🌐 www.jayantijay.com

For current appointments, Reiki training, workshops, retreats, sacred tours and general enquiries, contact Jayanti directly.

📍 Jayanti’s Healing Sanctuary
38 Murev Way
Carrara QLD 4211

🌏 ONLINE SESSIONS

Jayanti also provides spiritual guidance and healing sessions remotely via online platforms.


📅 APPOINTMENT TIMES

Monday — 10am–6pm
Tuesday — 10am–6pm
Thursday — 10am–6pm
Friday — 10am–6pm
Saturday — 10am–6pm

Other days by arrangement.

✨ JAYANTI WOODS
Jayanti is a gifted intuitive healer, Reiki Master-Teacher, contemporary Shaman and facilitator. She has a successful healing practice where she draws on a range of ancient and progressive healing therapies inspiring and empowering others to live their lives from a heart centred awareness. Jayanti has been leading regular meditation & chanting groups since the early 90’s.
